map.💰 成本法（重置/折旧/地价）综合: 💰 Cost Approach (Replacement / Depreciation / Land Value) Combined
map.按重置成本与累计折旧计算建筑物净值、折旧率与含地价总价值。: From replacement cost and accumulated depreciation, compute building net value, depreciation rate and total value including land.
map.📖 查看「成本法（重置/折旧/地价）综合 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Cost Approach (Replacement / Depreciation / Land Value) Combined User Guide"
map.成本法：价值 = 重置成本 − 折旧 + 地价: Cost approach: value = replacement cost − depreciation + land value
map.💡 建筑物净值 = 重置成本 − 累计折旧；折旧率 = 累计折旧 ÷ 重置成本；: 💡 Building net value = replacement cost − accumulated depreciation; depreciation rate = accumulated depreciation ÷ replacement cost; total including land = net value + land value (estimated at 30% of net value).
map.新建或特殊物业用重置成本+地价估算价值。: Value new or special-purpose property as replacement cost plus land value.
map.保险或入账时按重置成本乘成新率。: For insurance or booking, apply the condition rate to replacement cost.
map.成本法与收益法结果交叉验证。: Cross-check the cost approach against the income approach.
map.重置成本 800 万、成新率系数 0.85（对应已使用约 15% 耐用年限） →: Replacement cost of 8 million yuan at a condition rate of 0.85 (about 15% of useful life elapsed) gives an appraised value of 800 × 0.85 = 6.8 million; in cost mode this tool outputs total = A × B.
map.若单独地价 200 万，则总成本=重置 800+地价 200=1000 万，再乘: With land at 2 million separately, total cost = 800 replacement + 200 land = 10 million, and applying the condition rate gives a building plus land value of about 8.5 million.
map.成本法什么时候最准？: When is the cost approach most accurate?
map.新建房、学校医院等特殊用途或交易稀少时最适用，市场活跃住宅则应以比较法为主。: It fits new buildings, special uses such as schools and hospitals, or thinly traded assets; for active housing markets the comparison approach should lead.
map.成新率系数怎么来？: Where does the condition rate come from?
map.由年限法或打分法得出，本工具作为通用测算器取输入系数，专业评估请用语境更完整的成: It comes from the age-life or scoring method; this general estimator takes it as an input, so use the fuller cost approach tool for professional work.
